concurrency_and_state: All data structures (MyVector, MyHashTable, MyKeyMap.h, Mob.arrMobTemplate, Mob.lastMob, Mob.newMob) are unsynchronized and assume single-threaded Unity main-thread execution; no locks or concurrent primitives exist in this batch.
MobCapcha stores all camera, animation, and captcha state in global static fields (MobCapcha.cs:5-40), preventing multiple instances and persisting stale state across sessions.

NewBoss uses C# 'new' member hiding on 20+ Mob fields/methods (NewBoss.cs:17-86, 188-650) instead of 'override', splitting state between Mob base fields and NewBoss shadowed fields depending on reference type.

Mob.arrMobTemplate and Npc.arrNpcTemplate are global static arrays resized on demand via EnsureMobTemplateCapacity/EnsureNpcTemplateCapacity (Mob.cs:383-394, Npc.cs:55-66), while NewBoss accesses Mob.arrMobTemplate directly without capacity checks.
cross_module_questions: Does Service.requestModTemplate(templateId) deduplicate in-flight requests on the client, or can multiple Mob/NewBoss instances spam template requests?
How does Controller.frameHT_NEWBOSS populate frame arrays for Mob (6-row) vs NewBoss (17-row) templates, and what happens if a templateId is missing from frameHT_NEWBOSS?
Does TField.update() handle setting isFocus on pointer press independently, or does MoneyCharge.updateKey() (MoneyCharge.cs:200-210) leave tfSerial/tfCode focus out of sync on touch/mouse click?
Do any server-sent packets still send 0-byte or 1-byte arrays to NinjaUtil.readByteArray(Message), which skips reading when length <= 1?

findings.impact: Client NullReferenceException crash during mob death/knockback animation when hp reaches 0 without injureBy set or after startDie().
findings.root_cause: updateInjure() checks `(injureBy != null && injureThenDie) || hp == 0` then unconditionally accesses `injureBy.cdir`; updateMobWalk() checks `if (injureThenDie)` then unconditionally accesses `injureBy.cdir`.
findings.title: NullReferenceException on injureBy.cdir when mob dies with injureBy == null

findings.impact: NullReferenceException or IndexOutOfRangeException crash on boss spawn, update, or render if arrMobTemplate is null, too small, or template data is not yet loaded.
findings.root_cause: NewBoss directly indexes Mob.arrMobTemplate[templateId] instead of using Mob.EnsureMobTemplateCapacity() / Mob.getTemplate() null-safe helpers.
findings.title: NewBoss bypasses Mob template capacity/null guards and crashes on uninitialized templates

findings.impact: Calling Mob-typed references invokes Mob methods/fields instead of NewBoss implementations, causing state desync and wrong frame array indexing.
findings.root_cause: NewBoss shadows over 20 fields and methods (xSd, isBusyAttackSomeOne, injureBy, blindEff, sleepEff, setAttack, updateMobAttack, updateMobWalk, isPaint, isUpdate, GetFrame, etc.) with `new` instead of `override`. In addition, `case 7` in NewBoss.update() (line 289) calls `base.update()` into Mob.update().
findings.title: NewBoss hides Mob fields and methods with `new` instead of `override`

findings.impact: DivideByZeroException crash in NewBoss.paint() if maxHp is 0; NullReferenceException in NewBoss.updateMobAttack() if charAttack/dameHP/frameArr is null or type < 1.
findings.root_cause: NewBoss.paint() computes `(long)this.hp * 50L / (long)this.maxHp` without checking `maxHp <= 0`, and NewBoss.updateMobAttack() accesses `charAttack`, `dameHP`, `frameArr[type + 1]`, and `frameArr[15][type - 1]` without null/bounds checks (while `setAttack(Char)` at line 320 sets status=3 without initializing `charAttack` or `type`).
findings.title: Missing zero/null/bounds guards in NewBoss.paint() and NewBoss.updateMobAttack()

findings.impact: Boss position becomes framerate-dependent and snaps/drifts horizontally when moving vertically.
findings.root_cause: NewBoss.paint() mutates `this.x` and `this.yTemp` directly inside the render method based on tile collisions and `y != yTemp`.
findings.title: NewBoss.paint() mutates world coordinates (x, yTemp) during rendering

findings.impact: Stream desync if a 1-byte array is sent (1 byte left unread in Message stream), or OutOfMemoryException/OverflowException on corrupted negative/huge int lengths.
findings.root_cause: readByteArray(Message) silently skips reading when `num <= 1` (`if (num > 1)`), leaving 1 byte in the stream when `num == 1`; readByteArray(myReader) allocates `new sbyte[num]` with no bounds validation on `num`.
findings.title: NinjaUtil.readByteArray stream desync on len==1 and unchecked array allocation

findings.impact: NullReferenceException if GetFrame() fails to find templateId in Controller.frameHT_NEWBOSS, or if mob attacks with both cFocus and mobToAttack null.
findings.root_cause: Mob.GetFrame() casts `Controller.frameHT_NEWBOSS.get(...)` to `int[][]` and immediately indexes `frameArr[0]..frameArr[5]` without null/length checks; updateMobAttack() assumes `mobToAttack` is non-null whenever `cFocus == null`.
findings.title: Unchecked frameArr and mobToAttack dereferences in Mob.GetFrame() and Mob.updateMobAttack()

findings.impact: Multi-update projectiles can execute after removal and pass null Char to ServerEffect.addServerEffect(81, c, 1); trail cleanup skips elements.
findings.root_cause: MonsterDart.update() removes itself from `Effect2.vEffect2` without returning from the `nUpdate` loop, passes `c` (null when created with xTo/yTo) to `ServerEffect.addServerEffect`, and removes expired `SmallDart` elements at `j` without decrementing `j`. Same loop-skip on `GameScr.vMob.removeElementAt(j)` in `Mob.cs:778-784`.
findings.title: MonsterDart continues nUpdate loop after self-removal and skips vector elements on removal

findings.impact: Per-frame heap allocations in update()/paint() violate Client Zero-GC rules and increase Unity GC pauses.
findings.root_cause: `Npc.update()` allocates `new sbyte[7]` every tick while `effTask == null`; `Npc.paint()` allocates `new Effect` and concatenates `TileMap.zoneID + string.Empty`; `Mob.update()`/`MobCapcha.paint()`/`MonsterDart.update()` allocate `new Effect`, `new Char`, `new SmallDart`, and `templateId + string.Empty` strings inside update/paint paths.
findings.title: Heap allocations and string concatenation inside update() and paint() loops

findings.impact: Repeated calls to NinjaUtil.randomNumber() within the same tick/millisecond return identical values; duplicate entries in Mob.lastMob cause premature template eviction.
findings.root_cause: `NinjaUtil.randomNumber` allocates a fresh `new MyRandom()` (`new System.Random()`) per call instead of reusing a static instance. `Mob.getData()` appends `templateId + string.Empty` to `lastMob` without deduplication, so repeated reloads push out valid templates after 15 calls.
findings.title: Per-call Random instantiation in NinjaUtil and un-deduplicated Mob.lastMob LRU list

findings.impact: Minor dead code, boxing in hashtable keymap, and command hit-test edge case at y==0.
findings.root_cause: MyKeyMap boxes KeyCode and unboxes int on every map() call; mScreen.getCmdPointerLast treats `cmd.y == 0` as unset sentinel; Net.cs is fully commented out; Npc.update() has identical if/else branches at lines 176-183 assigning `GameScr.efs[98]`.
findings.title: Dead/redundant branches, KeyCode boxing, and cmd.y==0 sentinel edge case

module_summary: Batch client_gameplay_entities__p08 covers 21 Unity C# client scripts (5910 lines) in Assets/Scripts/Game1: core world entities (Mob, NewBoss, Npc, MonsterDart, MobCapcha), templates/data models (MobTemplate, NpcTemplate, NClass, MovePoint), UI screens/dialogs (mScreen, MoneyCharge, MsgDlg, NewPanel, mResources), and J2ME-compatibility utilities/collections (MyVector, MyHashTable, MyKeyMap, MyRandom, MyStream, NinjaUtil, plus commented-out Net). Key risks center on Mob/NewBoss architectural split (NewBoss using `new` hiding instead of `override` and bypassing Mob template bounds checks), null-dereference/divide-by-zero crashes in Mob/NewBoss/MonsterDart, stream desync on 1-byte arrays in NinjaUtil.readByteArray, and per-frame GC allocations inside update()/paint().
